title: Cuckold
summary: CUCKOLD, noun A man whose wife is false to his bed; the husband of an adulteress. CUCKOLD, verb transitive 1. To make a man a cuckold by criminal conversation with his wife; applied to the seducer. 2.

inlines.v: CUCKOLD, noun A man whose wife is false to his bed; the husband of an adulteress. CUCKOLD, verb transitive 1. To make a man a cuckold by criminal conversation with his wife; applied to the seducer. 2. To make a husband a cuckold by criminal conversation with another man; applied to the wife.
